conventions.steering_sign: e^{-j n psi}, n = 0..N-1 (0-based); e^{-j(n-1)psi} 1-based; NEGATIVE exponent
conventions.B_code_ref: rydberg_sim/reference.py:192  B = np.outer(c * alpha * a_b, symbols)
conventions.nmse_form: BOTH: per-trial instantaneous ||dG||_F^2/||G||_F^2 stored (monte_carlo.py:958) alongside error_energy and true_energy; AGGREGATE is ratio-of-sums sum(error_energy)/sum(true_energy) via NmseAccumulator.nmse_linear (metrics.py:386)
conventions.snr_formula_as_implemented: sigma2 = c^2 * sum_k(beta_k) / 10**(snr_db/10)   [total over K users]
conventions.m_step_expr: lam = M^H u + b; y = z*exp(j*angle(lam)); r = y - b; u = solve(M @ M^H + ridge*I, M @ r)
conventions.channel_adapter_convention: M = S (not conjugated), b = conj(B[n]), z = Z[n], output G_hat[n] = conj(u_hat)

gates.emgs_fixed_point_note: residual is the exact 1-R(kappa) bias, vanishing linearly in sigma2; truth is a fixed point only in the limit, which is correct EM-GS behaviour

kappa_stats.config: N=8, K=2, P=8, RSR=10 dB, SNR=5 dB, sigma2=0.632456
kappa_stats.R_implementation: scipy.special.ive(1,x)/ive(0,x) for x <= 1e4 (shared exp(-|x|) cancels); asymptotic 1 - 1/(2x) - 1/(8x^2) above; R(0)=0 exact; np.clip(.,0,1)
kappa_stats.cosmetic_caveat: at x=1e300 the asymptotic branch (gs.py:423) emits RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in multiply forming 8.0*x*x; the term correctly underflows to 0.0 and the returned value is correct. Observed kappa_max ~116 is ~298 orders of magnitude away. Unreachable in practice. No change proposed; noted so a future warnings-as-errors run is not surprised.

snr_rsr_check.method: ratio of summed energies over 400 realizations, N=8 K=2 P=8
snr_rsr_check.verdict: both implemented as documented; uniform ~0.09 dB finite-sample offset, consistent with row normalization holding in expectation not per realization
